title: FAME: Forecastability-Aware Mixture of Experts for Heterogeneous Time Series Forecasting
title_zh: FAME：面向异质时间序列预测的可预测性感知专家混合模型
abstract_en: Large-scale retail and industrial forecasting systems contain many heterogeneous time series whose lifecycle, sparsity, volatility, seasonality, spectral patterns, and contextual sensitivity differ substantially. A single forecasting model rarely performs well across all regimes, while dense ensembles increase inference cost and provide limited insight into expert suitability. This paper studies forecastability-aware expert routing: learning how data characteristics determine the suitability of forecasting experts. We propose \method{}, a sparse mixture-of-experts framework that represents each series with a multidimensional forecastability fingerprint, mines expert-suitability targets from validation performance, and trains a cost-aware sparse router to activate a small budgeted set of experts for each series. Using a production-scale vending-machine sales dataset from Shandong New Beiyang (SNBC), where the forecasting component has been integrated into the replenishment-planning pipeline, together with public retail benchmarks, we show that expert suitability varies systematically across data regimes. On the industrial dataset with 5,000+ machines and 60M+ transactions, \method{} Top-2 reduces MSE by 12.4\% over the strongest single expert, LightGBM, while executing 1.92 experts per series on average. The deployed component produces demand forecasts, while inventory-oriented gains are estimated by an offline replay simulator under a fixed replenishment policy rather than by online intervention. The framework turns heterogeneous sales forecasting from heuristic model selection into data mining of forecastability patterns and expert specialization. Code is available at https://github.com/hit636/FAME
abstract_zh: 本文研究大规模零售与工业场景中的异质时间序列预测问题。不同序列在生命周期、稀疏性、波动性、季节性、频谱模式和上下文敏感性上差异显著，单一预测模型难以覆盖所有数据机制，而密集集成又会增加推理成本且缺乏可解释的专家适配性。作者提出 FAME（Forecastability-Aware Mixture of Experts），一种稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 框架：先为每条序列构建多维“可预测性指纹”（forecastability fingerprint），再从验证集表现中挖掘专家适配目标，最后训练带成本约束的稀疏路由器，为每条序列激活少量专家。实验使用山东新北洋（SNBC）生产级自动售货机销售数据集及公开零售基准。结果显示，在包含 5000+ 台机器、6000 万+ 交易的工业数据上，FAME Top-2 相比最强单专家 LightGBM 将 MSE 降低 12.4%，平均每条序列仅执行 1.92 个专家。该系统已集成到补货规划流水线中，库存收益通过固定补货策略下的离线回放模拟估计。
key_points_zh: 提出 FAME，将异质时间序列预测建模为 forecastability-aware expert routing，而非手工模型选择或全量集成。
为每条时间序列提取多维 forecastability fingerprint，刻画稀疏性、波动性、季节性、频谱和上下文敏感性等特征。
通过验证集性能挖掘 expert-suitability targets，并训练成本感知的稀疏 router，为每条序列选择预算内的少量专家。
在 SNBC 生产级自动售货机销售数据上，FAME Top-2 相比最强单专家 LightGBM 降低 12.4% MSE，平均仅调用 1.92 个专家。
方法兼顾预测精度、推理成本和专家适配解释性，适合大规模零售与工业预测系统部署。

llm_assessment.comment: A useful retail forecasting and replenishment contribution, but it is peripheral to e-commerce agents, search, and recommendation.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该论文对零售需求预测和补货有帮助，但与电商智能体、搜索和推荐的核心方向关系较弱。
